title: Specified external Cech cup on pure factor homology generators
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with affine diagonals, and let $F,G$ be quasi-coherent modules on $X,Y$ [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $U,V$ be finite affine open covers of $X,Y$. Write $T,P$ for the tensor and product Cech functors [def-sc-picard-external-right-cech-models]. Suppose $\theta:T\Rightarrow P$ satisfies the front/back cochain-coordinate predicate of [lem-sc-picard-right-cech-cup-construction]. Write $A,B,C$ for the fixed scalar models of $F,G$ and their external coefficient [lem-sc-picard-kunneth-resolution-model]. For each $n\in\mathbb N$, put $I_n=\{(p,q)\in\mathbb N^2:p+q=n\}$. There are a $k$-linear equivalence $e:\bigoplus_{(p,q)\in I_n}H^p(A)\otimes_kH^q(B)\cong H^n(T(G))$ and an isomorphism $b:H^n(P(G))\cong H^n(C)$. For every $(p,q)\in I_n$ (write i for its subtype index with i.val=(p,q)) and factor homology classes $x,y$, (-1)^(i.val.1*i.val.2) times the result of applying $e$ to the summand inclusion of $x\otimes y$, then $H^n(\theta_G)$, then $b$, and then the fixed scalar-model comparison gives $\operatorname{externalCup}(\epsilon_A(x),\epsilon_B(y))$ [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations], with degree transported along $p+q=n$. The comparisons and generator formula are asserted together. No scalar-total cycle or comparison from scalar-total homology occurs in this statement.

proof.text: Obtain factor comparisons alpha,beta and product comparison b together with the geometric formula on natural Cech tensor cocycles.

Apply natural-indexed tensor Kunneth to the factor Cech complexes. Precompose its equivalence with the direct sum of tensors of alpha inverse and beta inverse, and postcompose with inverse extension homology to get e.

For each scalar-model class x,y, lift their inverse factor-comparison images through the surjective homology projections. Kunneth supplies a tensor total cocycle z. Simplify the direct-sum equivalence on the pure tensor and apply the geometric cycle formula; alpha and beta cancel their inverses. This is the complete Lean combination. The signed cycle comparison supplies the factor (-1)^(i.val.1*i.val.2) on the left, unchanged by the representative equalities and tensor Kunneth transport.

lean.statement:
theorem picardRightCechCup_generators
    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{w}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal f)] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal g)]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    {ι κ : Type w} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : κ → Y.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U i)) (hV : ∀ j, IsAffineOpen (V j))
    (hUc : iSup U = ⊤) (hVc : iSup V = ⊤)
    (θ : picardRightTensorCechFunctor f g U V F ⟶
      picardRightProductCechFunctor f g U V F)
    (hθ : IsPicardRightCechCup f g U V F θ)
    (G : Y.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent] (n : ℕ) :
        ∃ (e : (⨁ i : {pq : ℕ × ℕ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n},
              (picardScalarModel f F).homology (i.val.1 : ℤ) ⊗[k]
                (picardScalarModel g G).homology (i.val.2 : ℤ)) ≃ₗ[k]
              ((picardRightTensorCechFunctor f g U V F).obj G).homology (n : ℤ))
          (b : ((picardRightProductCechFunctor f g U V F).obj G).homology (n : ℤ) ≅
            (picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
              (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).homology (n : ℤ)),
          ∀ (i : {pq : ℕ × ℕ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n})
            (x : (picardScalarModel f F).homology (i.val.1 : ℤ))
            (y : (picardScalarModel g G).homology (i.val.2 : ℤ)),
            (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i.val.1 * i.val.2) •
              picardScalarModelEquiv (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
                (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) n
              (b.hom (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (θ.app G) (n : ℤ)
                (e (DirectSum.lof k _ _ i (x ⊗ₜ[k] y))))) =
              cast (congrArg (fun d ↦ ↥(scalarCohomology (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
                (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) d)) i.property)
                (externalCup f g F G i.val.1 i.val.2
                  (picardScalarModelEquiv f F i.val.1 x)
                  (picardScalarModelEquiv g G i.val.2 y))

statement_change.what: The old unsigned normalization omits the Koszul factor. scalarExtCup composes the left class first, so extracting the left shift before the right shift on the (p,q) tensor summand contributes (-1)^(p*q). The prior module's private scalarCup_yoneda_order and oddShiftTensor_component proofs verify the order and the (1,1) sign; oddTensorSummand_ne_neg and oddShiftTensor_not_unsigned show that the sign is nontrivial over the rationals. With the resolution and front/back Cech pairings kept unsigned, the scalar cup is (-1)^(p*q) times their class. Equivalently, the Cech-to-scalar comparison has (-1)^(i.val.1*i.val.2) multiplying its left-hand side. This is a normalization correction, with no new hypotheses; p=0 or q=0, even p*q, characteristic two, and zero classes reduce to the prior formula.
